summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (fifth-from-last positional order, width moved to fifth) and returns one Text object with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved; new docs/reference/tabs.md; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, plus new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py. Layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already declares min_size (default 1). Caveats: nothing was run, so tests and rich-behavior assumptions (Style + Style keeping meta, Text rendering without segment merging) are verified by reading only. Bar position indexes the full tab list and is mapped to displayed tabs by name, which keeps the underline under the active name with duplicate names. Character search only applies to single-character keys. Sandbox demo was skipped as optional. An empty label with auto-fit padding gets one flexible cell.
